# Site Publication Requirements Checklist: Prepare v1.1.0 public schema and site

**Purpose**: Review release, schema, artifact, deployment-verification and authority requirements for completeness, clarity and consistency before implementation

**Created**: 2026-09-16

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are current release version, tag, official URL and exact primary asset requirements all defined without relying on a mutable or remote build-time authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 through FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for adding v1.1.0 while preserving every older release document and immutable schema route? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002 and FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are the complete expected HTML, schema and download inventory counts documented consistently across specification, success criteria and contracts? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002 through SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for maintained current-state prose, generated adaptations, the release page, the landing page and detailed changelog without requiring historical evidence rewrites? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-002 and FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 Are both pull-request preparation and post-merge production phases documented with independent outcomes, owners and stopping conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015 through FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “exact official download” clarified by count, tag/version relationship, approved asset classes and uniqueness rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003; Public Site Contract §Release authority]
- [x] CHK007 Is immutable v1.1.0 schema identity quantified by route, source relationship, byte length and SHA-256 while prohibiting normalization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005 and SC-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is “current-state content” bounded sufficiently to distinguish maintained present-tense documentation from frozen historical preparation and release evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013; Research §Decision 8]
- [x] CHK009 Is exact-main selection unambiguously defined as equality with freshly fetched default-branch head rather than ancestry or a previously observed revision? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011; Production Verification Contract §Exact revision selection]
- [x] CHK010 Is public verification's local authority defined precisely enough to reject missing or extra remote routes, downloads, schemas and a mismatched content manifest? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do release identity and download requirements agree across the specification, data model, public-site contract and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 through FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Do route-count and schema-count requirements agree across the plan, specification and public-site contract without counting application fallback behavior as a declared content route? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Do immutable-byte requirements align with the documentation requirement that current prose be updated, avoiding any implied edit to released schema descriptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005 and FR-013]
- [x] CHK014 Do production hardening requirements preserve existing Cloudflare state, DNS, TLS, redirect and credential boundaries while narrowing revision selection? [Consistency, Production Verification Contract]
- [x] CHK015 Do issue/Project lifecycle requirements consistently leave #67, #51 and the milestone open while allowing the official PR to close #76? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 through FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can every inventory, schema identity, documentation-state, site-quality and review-completion outcome be measured objectively from the stated counts, digests and terminal states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 through SC-007]
- [x] CHK017 Are accessibility, responsive, link, metadata, generation-drift and dry-run expectations stated as zero-defect or otherwise objective outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 Is the two-round Codex limit expressed independently from the requirement to address every actionable finding? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-015 and SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are primary visitor, immutable-schema consumer and operator-review scenarios each independently testable and linked to requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK020 Are malformed release metadata, stale generated content, missing historical routes, schema byte drift, remote self-declared subsets, stale-main deployment and mutable alias exposure addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are failure requirements explicit for revision mismatch, metadata/manifest differences, incomplete inventories, schema mismatch and public or Cloudflare verification failure? [Coverage, Production Verification Contract §Failure handling]
- [x] CHK022 Is rollback intentionally excluded from this preparation and separated from the exact-main release gate rather than left ambiguous? [Boundary, Research §Decision 7]

## Non-Functional and Authority Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are deterministic generation, UTF-8/no-BOM, immutable bytes, static behavior, accessibility and responsive requirements covered at the right level without over-specifying implementation? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK024 Are pull-request credential isolation, production authorization, tag/release immutability and final-merge boundaries explicit and mutually consistent? [Security/Authority, Spec §FR-012 and FR-017]
- [x] CHK025 Are protected post-merge Cloudflare mutation and read-back requirements retained for #67 without claiming their completion in #76? [Authority, Production Verification Contract]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Are #66's verified release facts, #76/#67 hierarchy, prior immutable releases and established Cloudflare architecture documented as validated dependencies rather than unproved assumptions? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 Is the distinction between explicit branch/PR authority and absent production/final-merge authority documented everywhere it affects execution? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions and Plan §Lifecycle and Authority]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
